context.body: Dependence on the Father and shared divine works are asserted together.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Jesus says the Father works, the Son sees and does the Father’s works, gives life, receives judgment authority, and is to be honored as the Father.
observations.label: The Son does what the Father does: action

observations.body: Opponents hear equality with God; hearers must honor and believe.
observations.label: The Son does what the Father does: response

observations.body: my Father is still working · does likewise · gives life · honor the Son
observations.label: Words in John 5:17–30

payload.posture: Read John 5:17–30 as jesus and god evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The Son says he can do nothing from himself while claiming acts and honor associated with God.
payload.title: The Son does what the Father does
